transition.label: Transition time (ms)
transition.description: Duration of color fades on the keyboard. 0 turns fading off.

show_label.label: Show brightness next to the icon

tip.gradient: Two or three colors blended across the keyboard
tip.custom: Pick a color for each zone
tip.static: One color for the whole keyboard

hint.palette: Colors are picked from your Noctalia palette and follow your wallpaper.
hint.gradient: A blend between two colors, with an optional middle point on the zone of your choice.
hint.custom: One color per zone: click a zone in the preview, then choose its color.
hint.static: A single color across the whole keyboard.
hint.firmware: The keyboard runs its own effects.

firmware.note: No settings here: the keyboard runs its own effects and cannot be dimmed from the system.

strip.gradient-hint: Click a zone to put the middle point there.
strip.off: Keyboard is off (the preview shows your profile).

mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.tip: Copy the left half onto the right half, mirrored

python.title: Python 3 is required
python.body: This plugin ships a small Python script to talk to the keyboard. Install python3, then reopen this panel.

access.title: Keyboard access needed
access.body: {name} was found, but your user cannot control its lighting yet. A one-time udev rule fixes that; it asks for your password in a terminal.

none.title: No compatible keyboard found
none.body: This plugin needs a keyboard that exposes the standard HID LampArray lighting interface. None was detected on this computer.

setup.noterminal: No terminal available to run the setup. Run scripts/setup-access.sh from the plugin folder manually.

widget.waiting: LOQ RGB: waiting for the service…
